cost: G=floor(human_fraction*N_test), threshold review=G-C. Calibration labels on separate queries are charged once. Baselines spend G directly on test review.
selection: Every feasible pair of within-class confidence prefixes is considered using target scores only. Minimize maximum Jeffreys-smoothed calibration tail error; then estimated overall error, then larger minimum calibration support, then balanced class coverage, then negative acceptance count. Unsupported tails receive risk 1.
class_floor: Require at least ceil(0.05*N_c) accepted raw predictions in each class. Original LARA is retained even if a class is empty. Supplementary reserved-class LARA protects the most confident 5% of each raw class before acquisition, with their raw labels frozen.
ranking: 59 official DL2020 runs, original top-ten positions. Primary binary nDCG>=2. Also graded nDCG using linear 0/1/2/3 gains matching trec_eval defaults; automatic binary labels map to grades 0/2, reviewed pairs retain human grades. Both use zero gain for unjudged positions.
scope: Exploratory previously inspected benchmarks. Fixed frozen Qwen binary scores. COVID retains cached strict grade>=2 rubric, not pending proposal-aligned grade>=1 inference. No fine-tuning, new inference, statistical guarantee or novelty claim. Configuration saved before threshold evaluation.
